lines.speaker: Mrs. Ramirez
lines.text: Zuzu - perfect timing. I was just about to do my pre-ride check. Want to learn how? We'll do it together.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Ramirez
lines.text: Every ride, before I roll out: A, B, C, then a quick check. Air. Brakes. Chain. Then wheels, seat, handlebars. It takes a minute and it saves your day.

lines.speaker: Mrs. Ramirez
lines.text: Start with air. Squeeze the tire - should feel firm, not squishy. Front first.
